mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 4% in the same month as rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days due to tightened policy expectations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% while CPIAUCSL > 200 in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from a baseline of no policy change (p > 0.05) during the same regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 for three consecutive months predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as labor market strength supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns under the condition are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) compared to prior periods of similar labor growth.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 108 for two consecutive months, it signals resilient supply-side momentum that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite INDPRO > 108 for the two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 197 for two consecutive months, amid rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5%), predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days due to deflationary expectations.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < 197 and UNRATE > 5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) under the same conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for 4 months indicates a strong labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days when FEDFUNDS remains below 3.5%.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive when UNRATE remains below 4% for 4 months.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month rise in housing utilization (HOUST) above 2200 signals renewed demand for housing, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
Note: Since HOUST is the only supply/demand proxy available, the following uses it as a demand proxy. Adjusted for available proxies.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive during the two-month high in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS below 3.5% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 days as markets anticipate further rate cuts to support economic activity.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive month of industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 signals robust manufacturing momentum, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days in a non-recessionary regime.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not positive when INDPRO remains above 110 for the month.
